description: Source code for the 'remap' package, which handles tracking and mapping token locations in Go source text, particularly for use with the Go formatter.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a span of byte offsets in source text.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: A mapping between token locations in input and output source texts.

classes.name: tokinfo
classes.description: Records the span and type of a source token.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Reports whether a span is recorded in the map and returns the mapped location if found.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a mapping from original to new token positions.

methods.name: Compute
methods.description: Constructs a location mapping from input to output byte slices.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes source bytes into a slice of token info structures.
